description: Línea 1 del Metro de Panamá S.A.- Estaciones y trazado georeferenciado is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Metro de Panamá. Coordenadas geográficas de las 14 estaciones y trazado georeferenciado de la Línea 1 del Metro de Panamá. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Metro de Panamá. Its tags are coordenadas geográficas, estaciones georeferenciadas, georeferencia de Línea 1 del Metro de Panamá. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2022-07-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
